info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Valuation Update API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation Update API provides a mechanism for adjusting the valuation of financial instruments within the banking sector. Users can update the valuation parameters of specific instruments identified by 'param1', allowing for timely responses to market conditions. This operation is essential for financial analysts, portfolio managers, and risk management teams who need to maintain accurate and current valuations. By facilitating these updates, the API supports informed decision-making and compliance with regulatory requirements.

patch.description: This operation allows users to patch the valuation details of a specific financial instrument identified by its resource ID (RES-100045). The updated information can include changes in market data, valuation methods, and other relevant attributes to ensure accurate financial representation.

requestBody.description: This request body allows clients to update the valuation details of a specific financial instrument identified by RES-100045. The JSON payload must align with the specified schema to ensure valid updates.
